R-MODE1-004 Technical Mandate: "Design and Conduct a Cross-Sectoral Study to Evaluate the Financial Implications of Implementing Renewable Energy Technology on Electricity Generation, Transmission, Distribution, and Storage"

Keywords:
- electricity generation
- transmission
- distribution
- storage
- renewable energy technology
- financial implications

Summary: The Technical Mandate outlines a cross-sectoral study to evaluate the financial implications of implementing renewable energy technology on electricity generation, transmission, distribution, and storage. The study will analyze the costs and benefits of renewable energy technologies, including solar photovoltaics, wind turbines, hydroelectric dams, geothermal power plants, and battery storage systems. The study is expected to provide insights into the economic feasibility, technical potential, and environmental impacts of these technologies.
